reasons: Cited Sections 20.1–20.5 give a full Vendor defend/indemnify obligation for third-party IP infringement/misappropriation covering Customer and its Affiliates, plus indemnities for breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused data breach, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct — matching the preferred position.
Standard procedure (prompt notice with material-prejudice qualifier, cooperation, control of defence, settlement consent) is present in 20.4, and 20.5 supplies procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.

Customer's reverse indemnity in 20.3 is narrow (unmodified Customer-supplied material used as authorised, Customer's violation of law) with carve-outs, consistent with the rule's requirement that Customer's indemnity stay narrow.
Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims under 21.3, so they sit outside the general cap — better than the fallback's 3× super-cap; no deviation exists.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed and the deterministic check confirms Vendor IP indemnity is present; the rationale accurately reflects the cited text.
